description: Iroiro is a 100% vegan and cruelty-free semi-permanent hair color. Most vibrant and long lasting, our colors prove that natural doesn't mean weak. description: White kaolin, also known as China or white clay, is basically the mildest of all clays. It is suitable for sensitive skin. It helps stimulate circulation to the skin while gently exfoliating and cleansing it. It does not draw oils from the skin and can therefore be used on dry skin types. To use as a facial or body treatment: Mix clay with water until it forms a paste and apply to skin. Leave on for about 10-15 minutes and rinse off with warm water. This all natural clay can be used alone or blended with other herbs and oils!

bullets: Fight against body and face breakouts with our topical acne spot treatment. It contains potent acne-fighting ingredients that help banish those annoying little bumps, soothe skin and quell oil production.

MiraMist’s versatile formula helps you achieve the clean, clear and smooth skin you’ve always wanted!

listing.title: 16 Fl.oz Premium Jojoba Oil Skin Nail Health Care Moisturizer
bullets: Moisturizer – After dispensing any facial moisturizer onto your palm, try adding 5-6 drops of jojoba oil to make it into a super-moisturizer. Flakiness will subside and the moisturizer will have an improved feel on your skin.

Hair conditioner – You can mix a few drops of jojoba oil into your current conditioner or use jojoba oil on its own in the shower.* You can also add it to damp hair before drying. Also, you can add it to dry hair to promote shine. Jojoba oil also moisturizes the scalp, helping prevent dandruff.

Make-up remover – Since jojoba oil is not an eye irritant, nor allergenic, you can use it to remove eye makeup. It also easily removes foundation, blush, and lipstick. Lip balm – Apply a few drops onto your finger and apply to your lips for an extra-light alternative to lip balm. Lots of lip balms tend to contain comedogenic (clogs pores) ingredients, so jojoba oil is a nice alternative.
description: What is jojoba oil? Jojoba (pronounced ho-HO-ba) oil is a botanical extract of the seed of the jojoba tree (Simmondsia chinenis). Technically it is not actually an oil, but rather what is called a wax ester. Why do we care? Because out of all of the compounds in nature, this wax ester is the most similar to human skin oil (sebum). It is theorized that applying jojoba to the skin can "trick" the skin into thinking it is producing enough oil, thus balancing oil production. The bottom line for acne-prone people is that jojoba oil is non-comedogenic so you can use it without fear. Benefits of jojoba oil Provides all day moisturization – jojoba oil doesn't evaporate like water based moisturizers can. It is theorized, but not yet proven, that because jojoba oil is so similar to human skin oil, it can "trick" the skin into thinking it has produced enough oil and thus balance oil production. Very stable – jojoba oil does not become rancid or lose antioxidants even after long periods of storage. Spreads well and absorbs well. The organic variety is free of pesticides, GMOs, and is sustainably farmed. Massage oil – Jojoba oil is perhaps the best massage oil on earth. A little goes a long way and for people with body acne is a welcome non-comedogenic option. Note: The skin irritation which sometimes comes with massage may still promote breakouts. Shave prep - For men, put 8-10 drops or more of jojoba oil on your beard area beneath your shaving cream (lather from your cleanser or other non-comedogenic shaving cream) for a more comfortable shave. This helps prevent razor burn and leaves your skin feeling nice and soft.

listing.title: Bushbalm Bermuda Dark Spot Oil – Moisturizes, Fades and Softens Dark Spots, Relieves Redness and Irritation, Reduces Ingrown Hair - 30 ml
bullets: What is Bermuda Oil? A 100% natural and vegan skincare product that can reduce the look of dark spots found anywhere on the body. The scent will transport you to your favorite spa and a much-needed refresh!

How Bermuda Oil Works: with 6 natural ingredients working together to soften the melanin pigments that cause dark spots, uneven skin tones. The combination of fractionated coconut, lemon, and rare copaiba oil work to even and diffuse the appearance of scars and blemishes.

How to Use: Gently massage into the skin. Think bikini line, underarms, knees, or anywhere else you are experiencing dark spots. For best results pair with one of our scrubs (sold separately) and do this daily.

When to Use: For Bermuda Oil to truly work its magic, you should ensure your skin is fresh and clean with no build-up of dead skin cells (best done with our dry brush and exfoliating scrub, sold separately). Apply Bermuda Oil daily within the first two minutes of getting out of the bath or shower.

DHC CoQ10 Lotion, Alcohol-Free Hydrating Lotion, Intensive Moisture, Fine Lines, Aging, Collagen-Boosting, Fragrance and Colorant Free, Ideal for All Skin Types, 5.4 fl. oz.
bullets: This refreshing, fast-absorbing liquid lotion prepares skin for targeted treatments and more intensive moisture while delivering super antioxidant coenzyme Q10 to counteract signs of aging, like fine lines, wrinkles, uneven skin tone and loss of elasticity.

The collagen-rich formula promotes a firmer, younger-looking complexion. It helps prepare your skin to receive the maximum benefits from your moisturizer, while providing additional free radical protection from coenzyme Q10.

In the Japanese beauty culture, few antioxidants are considered as powerful as Coenzyme Q10 in promoting skin's integrity and youthful appearance. This powerhouse ingredient fights free radical damage that can accelerate signs of aging.

Liquid Lotion is considered an essential step in the traditional Japanese skincare regimen, preparing your skin to get the maximum benefits from your moisturizer. Mild Lotion is a great third step of the Japanese 4 step regimen.
Fragrance and Colorant Free. Ideal for all skin types.

listing.title: Aloe Life – Skin Gel & Herbs Ultimate Skin Treatment, 99% Certified Organic Whole Leaf Aloe Vera, Vitamins C, A, & E, Head-to-Toe Skin Care Support for the Whole Family, Fragrance-Free (1 oz)
bullets: PERFECT FOR CHILDREN & ADULTS: This organic skin gel derived from plants is versatile & safe for application on the face & scalp. This skin gel is safe for adults & children, & can even be used for brushing teeth.

HIGH-QUALITY FORMULA: We begin our extraction process by harvesting aloe vera leaves, which we then juice & thicken with Xanthan gum. Contains Valuable Yellow Sap (giving the gel its golden color) with actives traditionally used for skin support.
HELPS CONDITION DRY SKIN: Skin Gel & Herbs from Aloe Life seeps into the skin tissue to help condition & moisturize. The gentle herbal mixture is a natural remedy for skin sensitivity.

VERSATILE APPLICATIONS: With multiple uses and forms of effectiveness, this skin gel is ideal for burns, stretch marks, irritated skin, damaged & thinning hair, itchy scalp, & is even good for conditions such as jock itch & vaginal dryness.

MISSION STATEMENT: Our goal is to support a healthier, more enjoyable life with proper nutrition, education, & high-quality vitamins & supplements. All products by Aloe Life are designed to support health & body wellness for a healthier, happier you!
description: Aloe Life Skin Gel is an organically grown whole leaf aloe skin product. Aloe leaves are juiced and then thickened naturally with Xanthan gum, which makes this skin gel 100% edible. The all-natural ingredients allow this gel to penetrate the skin to aid in conditioning and moisturizing. It is safe for adults and children to use on troubled skin, face, scalp, hands, feet, hair, body, jock itch, and even vaginal dryness. It contains yellow sap, which gives the gel its golden yellow color, and is traditionally used for skin support. This gel is safe for burns, stretch marks, damaged and thinning hair, itchy scalp, after shave, as well as brushing your teeth. It contains skin nutrients and vitamins A, C, and E which are combined with chamomile and azulene extract sourced from Comfrey. The value of this aloe vera skin topical is tremendous. It’s easy to see why Cleopatra named aloe vera the beauty herb! Take your first steps towards a happier, healthier you today with Aloe Life Skin Gel. Aloe Life International Inc, a leader in the Aloe industry for over 30 years, was founded in 1991 by clinical nutritionist, researcher, and author Karen Masterson Koch. Her clinical experience and education in immunology working with the famous Dr. Virginia Livingston, MD, gave her a thirst for more research and natural health application. Studies at Dallas Fort Worth Medical University and other institutions around the globe on aloe vera launched her research into the whole leaf aloe vera concentrate which revealed amazing results and led to the very best - Aloe Life products!

listing.title: Urban ReLeaf Nail Repair Treatment ! Help for Damaged, Soft, Split, Thin & Weak Nails. 100% Natural Oils. Vegan. Helps Growth After Damage. Nourish & Condition Cuticles. Proudly Made in the USA.
bullets: Urban ReLeaf Nail Repair Treatment ! Help for Damaged, Soft, Split, Thin & Weak Nails. 100% Natural Oils. Vegan. Helps Growth After Damage. Nourish & Condition Cuticles. Proudly Made in the USA.

The perfect treatment for thin, splitting, damaged, and slow-growing nails. Helps restore damage from acrylics, gels, water, and overworking. Deeply moisturizes and helps prevent peeling. When acrylic or gel nails are removed, the natural nail is often damaged or weakened. Water further weakens nails during bathing & showers, housework, swimming, etc. This natural nail oil soaks into your nail tissue, making them stronger, nourished, and more vibrant. Easy to use dropper bottle.

Made with rich and restoring oils, this treatment applies silky smooth. It soaks in quickly, making an immediate difference in the appearance and ‘feel’ of your nails and cuticles. This earth friendly nail treatment oil is 100% vegan, natural, and contains NO lab chemicals, so it's is healthy for your body and will not damage your natural nails. (...and it’s also pretty great on toes!)
Directions: Massage oil into nails at least twice daily. Avoid glue-ons and toxic polishes. Treat your nails like jewels, not tools. Keep any rough edges filed smooth so nails don’t tear.
Ingredients: Oils of Grapeseed, Jojoba, Flaxseed, Olive, Essential Oils of Tea Tree, Lavender. 100% Natural, Gentle, Vegan.

listing.title: Dr Adorable Mustard Seed Oil 8 Oz
bullets: Mustard Seed Oil, Great in soaps, creams, lotions and for massage.
Used to treat chapped lips, diaper rash, dry skin
Usage Rate: 1-100%
description: Mustard seed has been used for centuries in India as a massage oil and for skin care, where the oil is believed to improve circulation, complexion and muscular development. The oil also has antibacterial properties and is high in omega-3 fatty acids. Mustard seed oil has applications in personal care products like massage oils and muscle rubs. While it is often used as a cooking oil in India, its strong aroma is an acquired taste. Mustard seeds, which mustard oil comes from, contain calcium, protein, vitamins A and E, alpha omega-3 and alpha omega-6 fatty acids. They also contain antioxidants; these components make mustard oil an effective hair growth agent. The vitamins ensure strong hair and prevent hair from falling out. Conditioning Because mustard oil contains fatty acids, it both conditions and makes hair stronger, which causes healthy hair growth. Growth Mustard oil encourages the circulation of blood. Mustard oil is a hair stimulant, meaning it causes hair to grow healthier at a faster rate. How to Benefit From Mustard Oil Massage mustard oil onto your hair and your scalp three or more times a week. Each time, leave the oil in your hair for at least three hours before rinsing it out with shampoo. You will have healthier, stronger, faster-growing hair in just a few weeks.

listing.title: John Frieda Frizz Ease Beyond Smooth Frizz-Immunity Shampoo with Frizz-Immunity Conditioner, 8.45oz
description: John Frieda Coconut Oil Infused Frizz Ease Shampoo and Conditioner is formulated to build up your resistance to dry, damaged, frizzy hair while making it more manageable and easily styled. Fight frizz and flyaways before they start with John Frieda Frizz Ease Beyond Smooth Frizz-Immunity Shampoo and Conditioner. Repairs and moisturizes damaged, curly, frizzy and coarse hair types with our unique coconut oil infused formula. It penetrates hair fibers, working from the inside out to fight frizz, combats the porosity of dry, damaged hair and creates an internal barrier. When used with John Frieda Frizz Ease Beyond Smooth Frizz-Immunity Shampoo, hair becomes more frizz-resistant; over time and with continued use, its immunity to frizz gets stronger, so hair becomes smoother and more manageable. When used with John Frieda Frizz Ease Beyond Smooth Frizz-Immunity Conditioner, frizz is reduced up to 90%, and with continued use, the hair’s immunity to frizz gets stronger. Infused with pure coconut oil, the shampoo gently cleanses, so hair looks and feels smooth, sleek, and healthy. Infused with coconut oil, the conditioner improves the texture of medium/thick wavy and curly hair types, so hair looks and feels smooth, sleek, and healthy. Protect against humidity and invest in the health of your wavy, curly or frizzy hair. Satisfaction Guaranteed

bullets: Natural and gentle enough for facial skin.

description: What is it? Persian Cold Wax is a natural hair removal product. It is known as Cold Wax and is a sugar based formula. This is a waxing kit, which means it comes with: 60ml of cold wax, 20 fabric strips and 2 spatulas. These fabric strips are washable & reusable. Who is it for? This is a kit for those wanting to fine to medium hair (not coarse?). Previously shaved hair should have at least 2 weeks of growth. If you have coarse hair, get in touch via Amazon, we’ll recommend another product for you. How do I use it? Lukewarm wax may be a better description than Cold wax. The wax should be a honey consistency, as a thin layer is required. NOTE: A thin layer of wax is very important to get the best results. Place jar in microwave 20 seconds. Apply a thin layer of wax, press on strip, zip off quickly and parallel to your skin and opposite the direction of hair growth. The waxing kit comes with instructions, for best results please read these carefully. Please do not be shy, our contact details are on the packaging, get in touch if you are having any issues. Technique can make all the difference. How do I clean it? Sugar-based waxes are easy to clean and water-soluble. Simply use a washcloth and water! More info on Persian Cold Wax: This washable hair removal wax can be used for facial waxing, leg waxing & body waxing. In the tradition of Eastern elegance & beauty in its purest form, Persian Cold Wax has remained unchanged since 1970. This proven hair remover works beautifully so, unlike any other. Persian wax is a luxurious cold wax also known as sugar wax. Made on the West Coast of Canada, it is Canada's number 1 cold wax. Persian wax contains all natural ingredients, the main ingredients are sugar, citric acid and water. This authentic sugar based formula has been trusted by women for centuries. Ideal for reactive, easily irritated skin, this hair removal wax will lift hair cleanly from the root for salon-smooth skin. Persian wax is long lasting hair removal. Hair removal by waxing lasts for weeks longer than shaving. Waxing removes hair from the root, discouraging re-growth over time. Detailed photo instructions come along with the waxing kit, be sure to read first for the best hair removal results. This kit contains everything you need for at-home body waxing.

listing.title: CeraVe SA Cream for Rough Bumpy Skin 16 oz
description: Cerave Renewing Sa Cream (Pack of 2) - CeraVe Moisturizing Cream: Salicylic acid cream to improve skin texture - A salicylic acid cream can exfoliate, soften, and smooth rough and bumpy skin, such as scaly skin on your upper arms and thighs (and all the chicken skin in between). CeraVe SA Cream for Rough and Bumpy skin is designed to improve skin texture and soften very dry, rough skin. Formulated with salicylic acid and lactic acid to gently exfoliate dead skin cells and bumpy skin—as well as hydrating hyaluronic acid and calming niacinamide—our cream for rough and bumpy skin, free of added perfume, helps improve your overall skin texture. The ingredients in CeraVe SA Cream, which include three essential ceramides, work together to lock in moisture and help maintain your skin’s protective barrier. Plus, MVE technology continually releases moisturizing ingredients for all-day hydration. Lasting hydration supports your skin’s protective barrier, long after you’ve finished applying. How To Use: Apply the salicylic acid cream to affected areas only, or as directed by a physician. Use a sunscreen or other sun protection to prevent sensitivity to the sun while using this product. Discontinue use if you experience any irritation or burning. Sunburn alert: This product contains an alpha-hydroxy acid (AHA) that may increase your skin’s sensitivity to the sun and particularly the possibility of sunburn. Use sunscreen, wear protective clothing, and limit sun exposure while using this product and for a week afterward.

bullets: WORK FASTER & MORE EFFICIENTLY - With countless advantages over traditional aluminum foil, the Easy Color is revolutionizing the way hair stylists perform highlights, lowlights, balayage, and other hair coloring treatments all over the world! This ENVIRONMENTALLY FRIENDLY product is 100% recyclable after use and features packaging made out of recycled materials! Recommended for professional use

TRANSPARENT& ADHESIVE – Check the hair color during processing time without having to open up foils! Hair firmly grips onto the adhesive allowing you to get closer to the roots and easily isolate small amounts of hair while providing a better working surface. Water-soluble adhesive dissolves once product is applied giving you the ability to massage the product throughout the hair to ensure full saturation and makes it easily removable when it is time.

NO CUTTING OR CLIPS – Each roll has 300 pre-perforated sheets and sits comfortably on your arm while you work; giving you whatever length you need by simply pulling and tearing! The sheets will firmly stay in place once applied without the need for clips or fasteners ensuring that no product spills or spreads to unwanted areas. Being lighter and less bulky than aluminum, even your clients will enjoy the added comfort and mobility!

SAVE UP TO 35% ON BLEACH & COLOR – Aluminum foil naturally oxidizes and dries out products; requiring you to use excess amounts and often have to add more throughout the process. The Easy Color does not oxidize product or let it dry up because its water-soluble adhesive helps keep the hair moisturized and also because exposure to air is greatly reduced. This allows you to achieve the same results using much less product which saves you money!

HEALTHIER FOR HAIR – Foil gets very hot and dries out the product and hair inside, exposing already parched hair to high temperatures for extended periods which causes severe damage. The Easy Color gets sealed along the sides creating a THERMIC POUCH with much better conditions for the hair coloring process which keeps the hair saturated the entire time with the additional help of the water-soluble adhesive which adds moisture to the hair when it dissolves.
description: The #1 alternative to using salon foil! Much healthier, faster, and efficient!
